desc:
CONTROL ONE PUPPET WITH YOUR FRIENDS 1-5 PLAYER CO-OP OBBY

Get one puppet through a dangerous obstacle course in Control a Ragdoll, a 1-5 player co-op obby where you and your friends each control different limbs of the same body.

Coordinate every step, swing across monkey bars, climb rock walls and dodge spikes, hammers and falling meteors on the way to the finish. One wrong move from anyone can take the whole puppet down!

🤝 1-5 PLAYER CO-OP  play solo or split the limbs with friends
😂 WHOSE FAULT?  the game shows exactly whose limb did it
🌋 8 WORLDS  from the Plains to the Ember Core
💾 CHECKPOINTS  no need to restart from the beginning
